rawFailedRuns.explanation: Server reported ready, but first Node source fetch failed before browser work. Initial error lacked nested socket cause. No root cause is asserted; later direct-byte source fetches and browser jobs succeeded.

The raw HTTP response already exactly matched the source file. The harness incorrectly decoded the first use-client directive as an export wrapper. Direct byte equality now proves identity; all fifteen final responses match installed bytes directly.
